taxi_day.basis: Two operator rate cards for an 8 hr / 80 km sedan day: Amritsar Taxi (amritsartaxi.com) Swift Dzire Rs 1,400 (Etios 1,500, Ertiga 1,600, Innova 2,000, Crysta 2,500), page says 'Fares last updated: 1 October 2026'; The RS Holidays / Amritsar Cabs (amritsarcabs.com local tariff, undated) Dzire/Etios Rs 2,000 (Innova 2,500, Crysta 3,500), GST 5% extra, parking/tolls/driver allowance extra. Central figure 1,700 = midpoint of the two direct sedan quotes; a traveller booking by WhatsApp with the newer dated card would pay ~1,400, a traveller on the other card ~2,000 (+5% GST). Gozo aggregator shows only a 4 hr/40 km sedan at Rs 1,282 before GST (no 8 hr package), consistent with a full-day sedan at or above ~2,000 through an app. Outstation 14/km is RS Holidays' Dzire/Etios round-trip rate (min 250 km billing/day, + Rs 200-300 driver allowance/day); Amritsar Taxi does not publish a per-km rate (extra km on the local slab Rs 8/km, extra hour Rs 100).
taxi_day.notes: Sights on the Amritsar Taxi day rate: Golden Temple, Jallianwala Bagh, Partition Museum, Durgiana Temple, Gobindgarh Fort; Wagah ceremony is an add-on (leave ~2:30 pm winter / 3:30 pm summer). Morning circuit (Golden Temple, Jallianwala Bagh, Partition Museum) 'fits into four hours'. Many visitors do the old city by auto/e-rickshaw/walking; NO current auto or e-rickshaw fare card was found. Only stale reference points from Wikivoyage (https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Amritsar, items dated 2014 to 2023): railway station to Golden Temple auto about Rs 20, e-rickshaw bus stand to Golden Temple Rs 10-20, airport to city by rickshaw Rs 100-200, Wagah taxi-stand quote Rs 1,600 (undated); treat as indicative only, not for pricing. Holidify says bus, auto and cycle rickshaws are available and cabs are for groups, no fares. Driver's toll/parking extra.
